subject_identity_preserved.rationale: All shots keep a large brown bear as the central subject, with broadly similar brown fur, rounded ears, dark muzzle, and adult build. Individual markings are not stable enough to be certain it is the same bear, especially across the close-up/foliage/rear-view cuts.

background_coherent.rationale: The setting generally remains an outdoor riverbank/forest habitat with water, greenery, mud, and gravel. Coherence weakens when the sequence jumps from natural riverbank motion to a tight educational-style close-up with graphic overlays, then to dense foliage and gravel terrain.

per_shot_adherence.issue: Matches a wet brown bear partially submerged in rippling river water, close-up and documentary-like.
Shows the bear near the bank, but it is not viewed from behind as captioned; it faces/turns side-on toward camera.
Bear is in lush riverbank vegetation and appears calm, but the frame is more frontal and river-adjacent than a clear left-to-right forest passage.
Caption asks for a low shot focused on paws/legs walking right-to-left, but the frame shows the bear's face and upper body in foliage.
Close-up bear face with visible graphic overlay elements, though only the initial overlay state is sampled.
Bear is partly obscured by foliage, but leftover yellow/red overlay bars are not part of this shot caption.
Dense foliage obscures the bear and suggests passage through underbrush, but the head is partly visible despite the caption saying it is not visible.
Rear/side view of bear walking away through gravel and vegetation broadly matches, though the setting remains more densely forested than the caption's open sparse terrain.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence preserves substantial variation in framing and action: water close-up, bank exit, frontal vegetation, tight face close-up, obscured foraging, body passage, and rear walking view. It does not collapse to a repeated composition.

motion_continuity.rationale: Sampled shots imply plausible progression from swimming/emerging to moving through riverbank vegetation and walking away. Motion is not frozen, though the abrupt close-up overlay segment interrupts the natural action continuity.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 3 to shot 4 most clearly breaks the natural documentary continuity by jumping from a riverbank/foliage walking scene to an extreme educational close-up with graphic overlays.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames are visually distinct with varied viewpoints and actions. No copied-frame or near-static collapse is evident, though overlay artifacts persist into later shots.
